_status: DESIGN, NOT AN EXPORT. Build it in the Fabric UI, then export and commit the real JSON after the pilot. No tenant has executed this.
name: pl_strata_recorded_ingest

parameters.WindowStartUtc: string, ISO 8601 UTC, validated by nb_validate_window
parameters.WindowEndUtc: string, ISO 8601 UTC, validated by nb_validate_window
parameters.PointBatchId: string, must exist in the control table; never free text

activities.name: nb_validate_window
activities.purpose: Parse both bounds as UTC, require end > start and within MaxWindowDays, look the point up in the control table, and return canonical literals. Fails the pipeline on anything else.

source.connection: ODBC via on-premises gateway (Basic or Anonymous per the connector matrix)
source.query: @concat('SELECT * FROM RecordedValues WHERE PointId = ''', activity('nb_validate_window').output.result.exitValue.point_id, ''' AND EventUtc >= {ts ''', activity('nb_validate_window').output.result.exitValue.start_literal, '''} AND EventUtc < {ts ''', activity('nb_validate_window').output.result.exitValue.end_literal, '''}')

activities.name: nb_curate
activities.purpose: Validate, replace the window in the curated table, then advance the control record. Idempotent.

activities.name: signal_complete
activities.purpose: Completion signal for the semantic model refresh.

notes: The query uses validated literals because ODBC ? binding in native code does not establish that Pipeline Copy can bind ? placeholders.
Test both connection string forms in the pilot: dsn=StrataPI and Driver={Strata Historian ODBC Driver};... Attributes after a DSN are dropped per Microsoft, so all settings belong in the DSN.
Run windows with bounded concurrency. Out-of-order completion is safe: the watermark only moves over contiguous COMMITTED windows.
